item.title: Tuberville defends post likening Mamdani to 9/11 attacks: 'I just go by his rhetoric'
item.summary: Sen. Tommy Tuberville, R-Ala., defended his controversial social media post comparing New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who is Muslim, to the 9/11 terror attacks.

item.title: Trump’s Strait showdown: Five bold moves to crush the Iran threat now
item.summary: President Donald Trump predicts commercial traffic will resume through the Strait of Hormuz within weeks as Operation Epic Fury targets Iranian forces.

item.title: Flight passengers are warned things could get worse amid DHS shutdown, delays and callouts
item.summary: The U.K. is warning travelers of potential U.S. airport delays amid the ongoing shutdown. TSA callout rates hit record 55% at some airports as unpaid officers quit or call out.

item.title: 5 disturbing examples that show why parents can't trust Fairfax County schools
item.summary: Virginia's largest school district prioritizes far-left policies over student safety concerns, from race-based discipline to alleged sexual assault to boys in girls' locker rooms.

item.title: BROOKE ROLLINS, ROBERT KENNEDY JR: We’re bringing families more healthy foods in a SNAP
item.summary: USDA finalizes rule hiking healthy food requirements for SNAP retailers from 12 to 28 varieties under Trump's leadership to combat chronic health issues.

item.title: Pro-life leader criticizes 'insane' UK bill that would decriminalize certain abortions up until birth
item.summary: Shawn Carney, CEO of 40 Days for Life, expressed concern over a U.K. bill aimed at shielding women from criminal liability for abortions up until birth, describing it as "insane."

item.title: FBI rescues missing teen from Florida hotel after month-long hunt for accused kidnapper
item.summary: FBI rescues missing 16-year-old Ohio girl after month-long search, arresting Tennessee suspect accused of kidnapping in coordinated multi-state operation.

item.title: Venezuela hero Eugenio Suarez taps faith after shocking Team USA: 'All the glory is for the Lord Jesus'
item.summary: Venezuela star Eugenio Suarez, who hit the game-winning double to beat Team USA in the World Baseball Classic final, thanked God and shared his faith after winning.

item.title: Venezuela shocks Team USA to win World Baseball Classic for first time
item.summary: Eugenio Suarez's game-winning RBI double cemented Venezuela as World Baseball Classic champions, shocking Team USA in a thriller final on Tuesday night in Miami.

item.title: Pittsburgh police officers accused of ignoring ICE agents’ struggle with suspect
item.summary: Pittsburgh police were allegedly told to stand down as ICE agents struggled with a suspect during a detention attempt. The chief has launched an investigation into the claims.
